events.deciding_variable: RPO converting to revenue exactly as the forward book implied: OCI +121% to $7.4B, total revenue $19.3B +30%, EPS $1.92 adj vs $1.74 est, FY27 raised to at least $90B and non-GAAP EPS $8.10. GPU utilisation 97.9%, 850MW of capacity added.
events.lesson: The forward book (RPO) is the real signal on this name and it converts - a book that is already months public can STILL be the deciding variable, which is the opposite of what AVGO taught. But the growth is being BOUGHT, not earned: non-GAAP operating margin was FLAT at ~42% on +30% revenue, capex was $28.5B in the quarter and free cash flow was NEGATIVE $5.4B.

standing_notes: Guides FY revenue and EPS explicitly in the press release and reiterates or raises the FY number every quarter, so a FILED same-period prior/new pair is always available. Reports RPO under RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation, so VEL is automatable and has been the deciding variable. Watch operating MARGIN and FCF against the prior QUARTER, not YoY - the AVGO lesson applies here even though this print did not break on it.
